## Systemic Repair Themes
1. Preserve channel honesty everywhere: Ch0 Metallic, Ch1 Roughness, Ch2 Clearcoat, with Ch2 raw 16 as max clearcoat gloss.
2. Treat hero-band finishes differently from pinfield finishes; do not optimize away water/flame/neon/oil streaks just to raise pinFlashScore.
3. Prioritize diffuse practical rigs when Low Sun/Night dominate; do not simply make already-bright lighting brighter.
4. Attack lazy specs by expanding Ch0/Ch1/Ch2 range, adding micro-detail, and reducing broad mid-glow.
5. For dark paints, verify preview luma parity before repeating void-floor fixes when darkGlossPct is pinned near 100 and darkVoidPct near 0.
